task: Design Bubbles/Ricky/Julian-based Goodville characters: promo title image + Preston Blair kits
resume_brief: In ~/workspace/trippedd-studio: create THREE new Goodville characters based on Trailer Park Boys' Bubbles, Ricky, and Julian (owner 2026-10-11). Parody exemption applies (owner override: parody likenesses don't need consent) — these are original Goodville residents riffing on the TPB trio, NOT direct copies. DO NOT invent personalities/backstories — visual design only; the owner assigns traits. VISUAL ANCHORS (keep recognizable, translate to South Park flat-cutout style): Bubbles = big glasses, goofy buck teeth, toque-ish hair; Ricky = greasy longish hair, striped shirt, goatee; Julian = tight black shirt, rum-and-coke in hand, slicked hair. All in the key-art style (assets/references/ep01/source/Goodville - Not South Park.png) — flat SP cutout, hand-built, NEVER AI-generated. DELIVERABLE 1 — PROMOTIONAL TITLE IMAGE: 'the first original Goodville promotional image' — the three characters as individuals in the Goodville world (town sign / storefronts backdrop), each clearly readable as their TPB inspiration, composed as a title card. Verify with your own eyes. DELIVERABLE 2 — PRESTON BLAIR KITS: separate-piece animation kits for each (same format as the Amos/old-head kits: head, eyes, mouths, arms, hands, body, signature props, manifest JSON with identity checklists). EXTRACTION N/A (no key art for them) — hand-build all pieces in SP style; document the construction. Work on branch feat/tpb-trio off origin/main, commit incrementally, heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/tpb-trio.json every 10 min, open a PR when done (do NOT merge). Report: design choices per character, promo image description, kit contents, frames/files verified with own eyes, PR URL. Mark done at the end.
